notes: New-source LSD coordinates; not copied from previous gate.
Tower centers/radii derived from robust actual-alpha ellipse fit; final alignment still requires browser collision overlay.
Canonical coping/cap world heights retain existing wall join profile; model solids and passage copied unchanged.
Do not merge axis claims until candidate mesh interior/line checks and browser review are complete.

Interior front-face interpolation controls are derived between the two independently measured coping/base lines; they preserve masonry rows while matching common profile, and are not counted as measured artwork edges.

Superseded inverse-projection rear-bed labels were duplicate approximations of the same front merlon cap rear edge, not independent native straight features. The actual cap edge remains directly measured by native LSD.

tower_fit.method: Robust soft_l1 least-squares on alpha>128 lower plinth contour, ellipse ratio tan30; source unchanged
tower_fit.model_center_alignment: X centers exact under shared scale/pivot; vertical mean datum with residual noted for browser review
